{{Top|leg}}
'''Magnetite''' was a metallic [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. It was the primary constituent of [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. Magnetite could be cleaned off objects with a [[Talking magnetite cleaner/Legends|talking magnetite cleaner]].
